# Disagreement Log — GTH_095

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 95
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 95 | "lend it at interest" | "lend it out at interest" | "loan it out for profit" | *toubo*: interest vs. profit |
| 2 | 95 | "Rather, give it" | "Instead, give it" | "Give it instead" | Adversative contrast word |
| 3 | 95 | "you will not get it back" | "you will not get it back" | "will never pay you back" | Non-repayment: factual vs. certain negative |

**Total disagreements: 3**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "lend at interest" (precise), "Rather" (stronger adversative), and "will not get it back" (factual non-repayment).
